description: This file defines the PollingState interface used for managing the polling state in ECU communication within the RomRaider project. It includes method signatures for getting and setting various states related to polling, such as current state, last state, query flags, and poll speed.

classes.name: PollingState
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to manage polling states such as current state, last state, and query flags in ECU communication.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current polling state as an integer.

methods.name: isNewQuery
methods.description: Checks if the current query is new.

methods.name: isLastQuery
methods.description: Checks if the last query was performed.

methods.name: isFastPoll
methods.description: Indicates whether fast polling is enabled.
